_readme: Why each entry of scripts/api-contracts-baseline.json was accepted (written by `pnpm findings accept`). scripts/api-contracts-baseline.json is a plain array the check reads as-is, so the reasons live here.

features/data-sources/lab/labServer.ts.reason: NDJSON stream from /ai/manual; typed-client is JSON-only (apiGet/apiPost) — same door as features/data-sources/server.ts

features/cloud-computer/service.ts.reason: Route GET/POST /browser-manager/cloud-computer is not in the generated client until the server deploys; same raw-client pattern as features/cloud-browser/service.ts

features/admin/tool-control/service.ts.reason: The /admin/tool-control routes are new and not in the generated @ai-matrx/api contract until aidream's contract regenerates and publishes; the raw client call moves to the generated operation then (same as open-outages)

features/cloud-browser/service.ts.reason: Pre-existing raw python-client import (stream-ticket, takeover, stream claim/renew on a foreign origin via requestRaw); 2026-10-17 Computer fix only added a view-mode option. Moving the whole Cloud Browser client to generated operations is its own change.
